item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Part of it, and I probably undercut myself with some subtly here, is that they're all about to be dosed with amnesiacs. This tale was a bit of an homage to the Lombardi tale Relationskips, and I try to make reference to what's happening throughout it… But then again, this also uses my personal canon of how amnesiacs work, too, which is to say: can only kill memory, not the emotions created by that memory, and some things can set those emotions off again. So, for instance, if someone really liked pie, and for God only knows what reason, they had pie erased from their mind, and then later had a piece of pie, they would get a rush of emotion they couldn't explain. Sorry, that's a terrible example, but oh well.

And yeah, the ellipses. Less a character trait and more my attempt to display how intensely uncomfortable he is doing this. He's never done it before, but he's seen it done by the person who regularly does, so… He's trying. Falling on his face of course, but he's trying.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Dunno if its part of the character or not, but all of the "…"'s bother me. Ellipsis marks are not toys! Do not abuse them D:

I can't really upvote this one, for two reasons.

1) I just don't think it's in the same quality range as the others. Nothing against you personally Troy.

2) It's so freaking short. Most of the other ones give at least an impression about what's going on. All that's being said here is "You're going to die". Yes, I realize that's the point, but it's not for the benefit of the orientees, its for the reader. As a reader…just doesn't give it to me. There's not enough here to really illustrate the dangers, or give any kind of background as to what they'll be doing. This seems more like a staff member talking to security staff that have worked for a while.

Sorry for the wall'o'text, just adding my 2 foundation issue credits.
